title: Direct image along an open immersion is fully faithful on etale sheaves
statement: Let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then the direct image $j_*:\Ab(U_{\Et})\to\Ab(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is fully faithful; equivalently, the counit $\varepsilon_G:j^{-1}j_*G\to G$ of the adjunction $j^{-1}\dashv j_*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is an isomorphism for every $G\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves].
